note: unseen-table: docs/227 §6 [UnseenTable] (ts3native 0.36.155 v149 + ts3fixes UnseenTable.cs 744-749, off by default), NOT RUN. Build feature/unseen-table (both commits), copy native/ts3native/out-*/ts3native.asi to game-copy/ts3native.asi.unseentable1 and the ts3fixes package to game-copy/ts3fixes.package.unseentable1. Order: smoke (auto), bp-utb-check + ip-utb-check (correctness + mismatch counters, Check=1), then the 4 in-load A/Bs (Check=0, probe on in both arms).
